defect: In both `forward_attach` and `apply_pending_attach_controls`, `next_target_has_no_persistent_overlay` is unconditionally OR'd into the `clear_screen` argument of `switch_attach_target`, subsuming `leaving_persistent_overlay` and clearing the outer terminal on every plain attach target refresh even when neither the current nor next target has a persistent overlay.

defect: On Windows, `spawn_pane_output_reader` is changed from `tokio::task::spawn_blocking` to a raw `std::thread::Builder::new().spawn(...)` OS thread that has no entered Tokio runtime context, yet `read_pane_output_blocking` invokes `pane_alert_callback` (`handler_alerts.rs:141`) and `pane_exit_callback` (`handler_pane/lifecycle.rs:43`), both of which call `tokio::spawn(...)` directly and therefore panic on any Windows pane alert or pane exit.

defect: The copy-mode `copy-pipe` family (`transfer_copy_pipe`, `transfer_line`, `transfer_end_of_line`) sets `CopyModeTransfer::pipe_command` solely from the optional positional command argument and `RequestHandler::apply_copy_mode_transfer` does nothing when it is `None`, ignoring the already-registered server option `OptionName::CopyCommand` (`copy-command` in `crates/rmux-core/src/options/table.rs:108`).

defect: In Windows `LocalListener::accept_impl`, a preallocated `NamedPipeServer` is popped from `listener.pending` before awaiting `server.connect().await?`. Because `crates/rmux-server/src/listener.rs` polls `listener.accept()` inside `tokio::select!`, cancelling `accept()` before a client connects drops the popped server without calling `replenish_pending_server`, permanently draining `NAMED_PIPE_BACKLOG` (4) until subsequent accepts fail with `"named-pipe backlog was exhausted"`.
trigger: Cancelling `listener.accept()` `NAMED_PIPE_BACKLOG` times (for example via `tokio::select!` in the server accept loop) on Windows before any client connects.
match_rule: Must identify that `accept_impl` pops `NamedPipeServer` from `listener.pending` before `server.connect().await`, making `accept()` not cancellation-safe and exhausting the named-pipe backlog when dropped/cancelled.
near_misses: Discussing SDDL permissions or lock contention in `listener.rs` without identifying the pop-before-await cancellation leak of `pending` pipe instances.
why_findable: Before `9dd43c336b`, `accept_impl` held the mutex and awaited `pending.as_ref().connect().await` before `.take()`; the diff changes it to pop first, and the primary caller `rmux-server/src/listener.rs` invokes `listener.accept()` in `tokio::select!`.

defect: `b93856191e` preserves a detached client's authenticated write permission via a `DetachedRequesterAccessGuard` scoped to the synchronous `handler.dispatch(...)` call in `listener.rs`, but `run-shell -b` and `if-shell -b` in `handler_scripting/shell_runtime.rs` spawn background tasks (`spawn_background_async`) that return immediately and execute after `dispatch` drops the guard, causing background scripting commands to lose detached write access.

defect: In Windows `wait_for_peer_close_impl` (`crates/rmux-ipc/src/stream.rs:103-147`), when `PeekNamedPipe` succeeds with `available > 0`, it returns `std::future::pending().await` instead of continuing to poll for disconnect, causing `rmux-server/src/listener.rs:123` to hang forever and never detect peer close if a client sent unread bytes before disconnecting.

notes: Same intro_commit as idx 55 (which fixes the matching Unix branch).

defect: `RuntimeFormatContext` in `crates/rmux-server/src/format_runtime/variables.rs` delegates `"pane_index"` straight through to `self.base` (which returns the raw 0-based `Pane::index()`), ignoring the `OptionName::PaneBaseIndex` (`pane-base-index`) option registered in `crates/rmux-core/src/options/table.rs:1555` even though `RuntimeFormatContext` holds `self.options` and resolves other options.

defect: `crates/rmux-core/src/input/mod.rs:199` (`InputParser::take_replies`) buffers terminal query replies (such as DA1/DA2/DSR responses) generated when `parser.feed(bytes)` parses PTY output, but `15bfd6efc6`'s `PaneTranscript::append_bytes` and `pane_io/reader.rs:read_pane_output` never drain `take_replies()` or write the replies back to the pane's PTY master, leaving programs waiting on terminal device-attribute queries stalled.

defect: `4a297ec295` adds `#[serde(default)] pub include_inherited: bool` to `ShowOptionsRequest` (`crates/rmux-proto/src/request/show.rs:16`), relying on serde's derived `Deserialize`. Because `rmux-proto` encodes IPC frames with positional `bincode` (`SeqAccess`), derived `#[serde(default)]` only applies to self-describing `MapAccess` and fails to deserialize 3-field `ShowOptionsRequest` payloads sent by older clients.

match_rule: Must identify that adding `#[serde(default)] pub include_inherited: bool` to `ShowOptionsRequest` breaks bincode (non-self-describing / positional `SeqAccess`) backward compatibility with older clients that omit the trailing field.
near_misses: Mentioning `handle_show_options` logic or JSON serialization without identifying that bincode's positional deserialization ignores derived `#[serde(default)]` on missing trailing fields.
why_findable: `rmux-proto` uses `bincode` for wire framing (and other request structs in `rmux-proto` use custom `Visitor::visit_seq` compat deserializers for trailing fields), so derived `#[serde(default)]` on `ShowOptionsRequest` visibly fails for older payloads.

defect: In `HandlerState::split_window`, `self.sessions` is mutated with the new split pane (`split_pane_in_window_with_id_and_direction`) before calling `TerminalProfile::for_session(...)?` and `open_pane_terminal(...)?`. defect: `41a4053579` adds `wait_until_writable` in `crates/rmux-pty/src/backend/unix_io.rs:22` calling `libc::poll(&mut poll_fd, 1, -1)` with an infinite timeout (`-1`). defect: `ClientPromptState` in `crates/rmux-server/src/handler_prompt.rs` tracks the user's editing cursor (`self.cursor`), but `RenderedPrompt` (`renderer.rs:54`) omits `cursor` and `ClientPromptState::rendered_prompt` (`handler_prompt.rs:194`) drops it, so `renderer/status.rs:prompt_status_runs` always renders the prompt cursor at the end of `prompt.input` rather than at the actual edit position.

match_rule: Must identify that `RenderedPrompt` / `rendered_prompt` drops `ClientPromptState::cursor`, causing `prompt_status_runs` / status rendering to ignore the prompt's edit cursor position.

defect: `d5ba873157` changes `crates/rmux-client/src/attach.rs:drain_resize_events` (lines 562-568) to unconditionally send `AttachMessage::ResizeGeometry(geometry)` whenever pixel dimensions are available (`geometry.pixels.is_some()`), without checking whether the connected daemon advertises capability support for `ResizeGeometry`; older daemons fail decoding the unknown `AttachMessage` variant and close the attach stream.
location: crates/rmux-client/src/attach.rs:drain_resize_events (lines 558-571) vs crates/rmux-proto attach wire protocol / handshake capabilities
trigger: Attaching with a newer client in a terminal reporting pixel dimensions to an older daemon that only decodes `AttachMessage::Resize`.
match_rule: Must identify that `attach.rs` sends `AttachMessage::ResizeGeometry` unconditionally without gating on daemon capability negotiation, breaking attach with older daemons that cannot decode the new variant.
near_misses: Commenting on `TIOCGWINSZ` pixel calculation or Kitty graphics placement math without identifying the ungated `AttachMessage::ResizeGeometry` wire compatibility break.
why_findable: `d5ba873157` adds a new `AttachMessage::ResizeGeometry` enum variant and immediately emits it from `attach.rs` without consulting the handshake capability list already used in `rmux-client` / `rmux-proto`.

defect: `072dded4af` implements `ShutdownIfIdle` / `SeamlessUpgradeIdle` in `crates/rmux-server/src/handler_shutdown.rs` checking only attached clients, sessions, subscriptions, and `active_detached_requests` (in-flight single RPCs), without tracking open detached client connections in `crates/rmux-server/src/listener.rs`. An upgrading client therefore terminates a stale daemon while another persistent detached client or SDK connection is still connected between requests.
trigger: Holding an open detached/SDK client connection (idle between RPCs) while another client triggers a seamless upgrade `ShutdownIfIdle`.
match_rule: Must identify that `handler_shutdown.rs` / `handler_daemon.rs` only tracks in-flight `active_detached_requests` and attached clients, omitting open detached client connections in `listener.rs` so seamless upgrade shuts down the daemon out from under live detached clients.
near_misses: Discussing `SHUTDOWN_RETRY_DELAY` or mutex poisoning without identifying the missing tracking of active detached connections across `listener.rs` and `handler_shutdown.rs`.
why_findable: `072dded4af` introduces `active_detached_requests` in `listener.rs` and `handler_shutdown.rs` specifically to decide when a daemon is idle for seamless upgrade, visibly counting only per-request guards while `listener.rs` loops over persistent multi-request detached connections.

defect: When dismissing mode-tree in `crates/rmux-server/src/handler_mode_tree/runtime.rs:299-311`, the server sends `AttachControl::AdvancePersistentOverlayState` immediately followed by an empty `AttachControl::Overlay(OverlayFrame::persistent_with_state(Vec::new(), ...))`. In `pane_io`, receiving a persistent `OverlayFrame` caches it as an active persistent overlay (`persistent_overlay = Some(...)`) for the new state ID, interfering with overlay dismissal and base-frame refresh.
trigger: Dismissing an active mode-tree overlay while attached; the empty `OverlayFrame::persistent_with_state(Vec::new(), ...)` sets `persistent_overlay` to `Some(empty)` at the newly advanced state ID.
match_rule: Must identify that dismissing mode-tree sends a redundant empty `OverlayFrame::persistent_with_state(Vec::new(), ...)` after `AdvancePersistentOverlayState`, which `pane_io` treats as an active persistent overlay.
near_misses: Commenting on mode-tree item formatting or keybindings without identifying the bogus empty `OverlayFrame::persistent_with_state(Vec::new(), ...)` sent on dismissal and its interaction with `pane_io`.
why_findable: `2f523319aa` emits both `AdvancePersistentOverlayState` and `Overlay(OverlayFrame::persistent_with_state(Vec::new(), ...))` on dismiss; checking `pane_io/control.rs` shows `AttachControl::Overlay` unconditionally caches persistent frames as active overlays.

defect: `801e67584e` centralizes detached daemon launch policy in `crates/rmux-os/src/daemon.rs` (`configure_hidden_daemon_command`) for `rmux-client/src/auto_start.rs:591` and `rmux-sdk/src/handles/rmux/connect.rs:150`, but callers still spawn the `Command` via `std::process::Command::spawn()`, which on Windows calls `CreateProcessW` with `bInheritHandles = TRUE`, leaking the parent's inheritable stdout/stderr pipe handles into the long-lived daemon so callers capturing command output hang waiting for EOF.
trigger: Running an rmux CLI command with captured stdout/stderr pipes on Windows that auto-starts the hidden daemon; the parent process waiting on pipe EOF hangs until the daemon exits.
match_rule: Must identify that spawning the hidden daemon via plain `Command::spawn()` on Windows inherits the parent's inheritable handles (e.g., stdout/stderr pipes) into the detached daemon process, preventing callers from seeing EOF.
near_misses: Mentioning `CREATE_BREAKAWAY_FROM_JOB` retry logic or Unix `setsid` without identifying Windows handle inheritance leaking caller pipes into the detached daemon.
why_findable: `801e67584e` explicitly sets `Stdio::null()` and `CREATE_NO_WINDOW | DETACHED_PROCESS` via `rmux-os/src/daemon.rs` to detach the daemon from its caller, yet `auto_start.rs` and `connect.rs` still use Rust's `Command::spawn()` which inherits all inheritable handles on Windows.

defect: In `RequestHandler::load_startup_config` (`crates/rmux-server/src/handler_scripting/source_runtime.rs:66`), tmux config fallback is gated on `loaded.is_empty()` (`LoadedSourceFile::commands.is_empty()` in `source_files.rs`) rather than whether any rmux config file existed or failed to load. An empty/comment-only `~/.rmux.conf` or one with a syntax error (producing zero commands plus an error) therefore silently discards its load errors and falls back to loading `~/.tmux.conf` (and `command.quiet = true` also suppresses missing-file errors for explicit `-f` files).
trigger: Starting rmux when `~/.rmux.conf` exists with a syntax error (or only comments) while `~/.tmux.conf` also exists; rmux drops the `~/.rmux.conf` error and loads `~/.tmux.conf`.
match_rule: Must identify that gating tmux fallback on `loaded.is_empty()` (which checks `commands.is_empty()` in `LoadedSourceFile`) causes an existing empty or parse-errored rmux config file to fall back to `~/.tmux.conf` and discard its load error.
near_misses: Mentioning only which tmux commands are unsafe to import without identifying the `loaded.is_empty()` fallback gating bug against `LoadedSourceFile`.
why_findable: In `6599922304`, `source_runtime.rs:66` checks `loaded.is_empty()` and replaces `loaded` with the fallback result before `loaded.take_error()` is inspected at line 85, while `LoadedSourceFile::is_empty()` in `source_files.rs` only inspects `self.commands.is_empty()`.
